'''NCWildKarrde BHBM v 2.0''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[NCWildKarrde]]
* '''Published:''' 12 April 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif|label=Bring Him Before Me}}
* '''Strategy:''' Bring Him Before Me
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 BHBM NCWildKarrde DS 2003 BHBMv20.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Second version of BHBM, added some cards I found and a couple that I had been suggested to use.

The published list has 62 cards.

== Strategy ==

IAO/SP allows me to pull my docking bays. The royal guards have a chance to add battle destiny. Sim Aloo and Myn Kyneugh allows for 2 more battle destinies. Crush the Rebellion allows me to pull I have you now and Evader. Blaster Rack will help me break out all of the lightsabers. I use Much Anger in Him to force a battle to take place. Mob points allows me to add more generation at the docking bays. I don't have any EPP or Ref III cards to use. Also don't have the combos. Still looking for suggestions to help me out.
